lines.zh: 铁靴踩过石阶，回声很旧。
lines.en: My iron boots cross the stone stair; the echo is old.

lines.zh: 面甲下的骨头在响。
lines.en: The bones beneath my visor rattle as I go.

lines.zh: 盔甲沉，可我从不需要歇。
lines.en: This armor is heavy, yet I never need to rest.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩出旧战场的节奏。
lines.en: Each step keeps the rhythm of an old battlefield.

lines.zh: 剑鞘空着，剑在手里。
lines.en: My scabbard is empty; the sword stays in my hand.

lines.zh: 队列早散了，我还走直线。
lines.en: The column scattered long ago; I still walk straight.

lines.zh: 铁片磨着铁片，像在数拍子。
lines.en: Plate grinds on plate, counting out a slow beat.

lines.zh: 我沿着城墙根走，那里最暗。
lines.en: I walk the base of the wall, where the shade is deepest.

lines.zh: 风穿过盔缝，吹出哨音。
lines.en: Wind slips through my visor and whistles softly.

lines.zh: 走慢些，这身铁不许我踉跄。
lines.en: I walk slowly; this iron will not let me stumble.

lines.zh: 脚印留在泥里，深得像坑。
lines.en: My footprints sink into the mud like small pits.

lines.zh: 前面的路，我记得是往王座去的。
lines.en: This road, I recall, once led toward a throne.

lines.zh: 站定，把剑尖抵在土里。
lines.en: I plant my sword tip in the dirt and stand still.

lines.zh: 盔里透不进气，也不需要。
lines.en: No air reaches inside this helm, and none is needed.

lines.zh: 我在听远处的钟，钟早停了。
lines.en: I listen for a distant bell that stopped long ago.

lines.zh: 骨头缝里积了灰，我不去拂。
lines.en: Dust gathers in my joints; I do not brush it off.

lines.zh: 这面甲挡得住光，也挡得住脸。
lines.en: This visor blocks the light, and hides whatever face I had.

lines.zh: 手臂举久了，铁会自己发响。
lines.en: Held up too long, the iron starts to sound on its own.

lines.zh: 我记得披风，可它早烂在土里。
lines.en: I remember a cloak, but it rotted into the soil.

lines.zh: 有只鸟落在我的肩甲上。
lines.en: A bird has landed on my shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 等号令，号令一直没来。
lines.en: I wait for an order that never comes.

lines.zh: 空空的胸腔里，只有风在转。
lines.en: Inside my hollow chest, only wind turns.

lines.zh: 你没穿盔甲，站得太靠前了。
lines.en: You wear no armor, and you stand too far forward.

lines.zh: 我在数你身上有几处破绽。
lines.en: I am counting the openings in your guard.

lines.zh: 你的眼皮会动，我的早没了。
lines.en: Your eyelids move; mine were lost long ago.

lines.zh: 抬起头，让我看看你的骨相。
lines.en: Lift your head; let me read the shape of your bones.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁锈味，是新打的。
lines.en: You smell of new-forged iron and rust.

lines.zh: 别把手放在剑柄上，我先看见的。
lines.en: Do not reach for your hilt; I saw it first.

lines.zh: 你走路的样子，像个还没上过阵的。
lines.en: You walk like someone who has never held a line.

lines.zh: 站住。让我把你看清楚。
lines.en: Stand still. Let me see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我脚边，很短。
lines.en: Your shadow falls at my feet, very short.

lines.zh: 我认得活人，也认得活人的害怕。
lines.en: I know the living, and I know their fear.

lines.zh: 甲片凹进去，我没退。
lines.en: A plate dents inward; I do not step back.

lines.zh: 这一下打穿了两层铁。
lines.en: That blow went through two layers of iron.

lines.zh: 骨头裂了条缝，还能走。
lines.en: A bone cracked along one seam; I can still walk.

lines.zh: 血早干了，流不出什么。
lines.en: My blood dried long ago; little can flow now.

lines.zh: 你打中了盔缝，运气不错。
lines.en: You hit a seam in my plate; good luck.

lines.zh: 我听见自己盔里有什么在松。
lines.en: Something inside my armor has come loose.

lines.zh: 退一步，重新端平剑。
lines.en: One step back, and the sword comes level again.

lines.zh: 疼这个字，我记不清了。
lines.en: I have forgotten what pain is called.

lines.zh: 铁可以补，骨头可以捆。
lines.en: Iron can be patched; bone can be bound.

lines.zh: 你耗得起几剑？我耗得起。
lines.en: How many cuts can you afford? I can afford many.

lines.zh: 食物？我的胃早化成土了。
lines.en: Food? My stomach turned to soil ages ago.

lines.zh: 你举着的东西，我看不出用处。
lines.en: Whatever you hold up, I see no use in it.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只缺一副好骨头。
lines.en: I am not hungry; I only lack good bones.

lines.zh: 拿开，铁盔里塞不进你的好意。
lines.en: Put it away; kindness does not fit inside this helm.

lines.zh: 你喂我，我也不会为你停下剑。
lines.en: Feed me, and my sword still will not spare you.

lines.zh: 我尝不出味道，只尝得出铁。
lines.en: I taste nothing but iron.

lines.zh: 放下吧，我的牙早掉光了。
lines.en: Set it down; my teeth fell out long ago.

lines.zh: 这点香气，穿不过我的面甲。
lines.en: That scent cannot get through my visor.

lines.zh: 我追的是活物，不是果子。
lines.en: I chase the living, not fruit.

lines.zh: 你想用吃的换命，价开低了。
lines.en: You would trade food for your life; the price is low.

lines.zh: 撞上我的铁，你会先退。
lines.en: Hit my iron, and you will be the one to step back.

lines.zh: 站稳，我的肩甲比门还硬。
lines.en: Stand firm; my pauldron is harder than a door.

lines.zh: 你撞的是骨头，不是软肉。
lines.en: You struck bone, not soft flesh.

lines.zh: 让开，重甲转弯要三步。
lines.en: Step aside; turning in heavy plate takes three paces.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我盔上的灰震掉了。
lines.en: That knocked the dust off my helm.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，剑会在中间。
lines.en: Do not press so close; the sword sits between us.

lines.zh: 我纹丝没动，你倒是晃了。
lines.en: I did not shift; you are the one swaying.

lines.zh: 铁碰铁，声音传得很远。
lines.en: Iron on iron carries a long way.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞上来，像敲钟。
lines.en: Your shoulder struck me like a bell being rung.

lines.zh: 退后，我的靴子踩下去不留空。
lines.en: Back away; my boot leaves no room where it lands.

lines.zh: 我这一族不生，只站着等。
lines.en: My kind does not breed; we only stand and wait.

lines.zh: 军团的床铺空了，也没人补。
lines.en: The legion's bunks are empty, and no one refills them.

lines.zh: 我曾有过同伴，如今只剩甲片。
lines.en: I had companions once; now only armor plates remain.

lines.zh: 别在我面前谈后代，我没有。
lines.en: Do not speak of heirs before me; I have none.

lines.zh: 骸骨不生骸骨，只叠在一起。
lines.en: Bones do not birth bones; they only stack together.

lines.zh: 这一排盔甲，都是我的兄弟。
lines.en: Every suit in this row was my brother.

lines.zh: 没有婚约，只有同一道军令。
lines.en: No vows bound us, only the same order.

lines.zh: 我的王没留血脉，只留了盔。
lines.en: My king left no bloodline, only armor.

lines.zh: 想延续什么，你得先有血肉。
lines.en: To carry anything on, you need flesh first.

lines.zh: 安静些，我在替他们守空位。
lines.en: Be quiet; I am keeping their empty places.

lines.zh: 这块铁归我，正好补肩甲。
lines.en: This iron is mine; it will patch my pauldron.

lines.zh: 捡起来，挂在腰后当备件。
lines.en: I pick it up and hang it behind my belt as a spare.

lines.zh: 剑缺了口，这块料能磨回来。
lines.en: My blade is nicked; this stock can grind it true.

lines.zh: 地上的骨头，我会收进盔里。
lines.en: Bones on the ground go inside my armor.

lines.zh: 我拿走它，不问它原先属于谁。
lines.en: I take it, never asking who it belonged to.

lines.zh: 这东西轻，塞进盔缝刚好。
lines.en: It is light; it fits neatly into a seam of my plate.

lines.zh: 有用的留下，没用的丢回土里。
lines.en: What is useful stays; the rest goes back to the soil.

lines.zh: 铁匠死了，捡东西的活归我。
lines.en: The smith is dead; scavenging falls to me.

lines.zh: 我数过，这堆够修一次护腕。
lines.en: I have counted; this pile mends one bracer.

lines.zh: 你掉的，我收了，别伸手要。
lines.en: You dropped it, I claimed it; do not reach for it.

lines.zh: 找到了。活人的热气很好认。
lines.en: Found one. Living warmth is easy to pick out.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，在石板上太亮了。
lines.en: Your footsteps ring too brightly on the stone.

lines.zh: 队列注意，前面有一个。
lines.en: Column, attend: there is one ahead.

lines.zh: 我看见你的手在抖。就你了。
lines.en: I see your hand shaking. You will do.

lines.zh: 别回头，我已经锁住你了。
lines.en: Do not look back; I have already fixed on you.

lines.zh: 这副盔甲总算有用处了。
lines.en: At last this armor has a purpose.

lines.zh: 呼吸声，两下，很快。找到了。
lines.en: Two breaths, quick ones. Found you.

lines.zh: 你踩断的树枝，替我指了路。
lines.en: The branch you snapped pointed me to you.

lines.zh: 目标确认，剑锋向前。
lines.en: Target confirmed; the blade comes forward.

lines.zh: 我闻到汗了，很近。
lines.en: I smell sweat, and it is close.

lines.zh: 那边的影子动了，不是风。
lines.en: That shadow moved; it was not the wind.

lines.zh: 你选错了地方站着。
lines.en: You chose the wrong place to stand.

lines.zh: 集合号在心里响了一声。
lines.en: A muster horn sounds once inside my chest.

lines.zh: 旧的命令苏醒，指向你。
lines.en: An old command wakes and points at you.

lines.zh: 铁盔转过去，我认下你了。
lines.en: My helm turns, and I have chosen you.

lines.zh: 我在一步步缩短这段距离。
lines.en: I am closing this distance one slow step at a time.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，我就省力了。
lines.en: Retreat to the wall and you save me the walk.

lines.zh: 这身铁走得慢，可不会停。
lines.en: This iron walks slowly, but it does not stop.

lines.zh: 举盾吧，我等着看它裂开。
lines.en: Raise your shield; I want to watch it split.

lines.zh: 你换方向，我就多走两步。
lines.en: Turn another way, and I take two more steps.

lines.zh: 我的剑抬起来了，你看得见。
lines.en: My sword is rising; you can see it.

lines.zh: 数到三，我就落剑。
lines.en: I count to three, then the blade falls.

lines.zh: 你身后没路了，我走过那条巷。
lines.en: No road behind you; I have walked that alley.

lines.zh: 面甲后没有表情，只有瞄准。
lines.en: Behind the visor there is no expression, only aim.

lines.zh: 心跳声越响，说明我越近。
lines.en: The louder your heart, the closer I am.

lines.zh: 别指望我累，我不会累。
lines.en: Do not hope I tire; I do not tire.

lines.zh: 你的同伴跑了，我不追他。
lines.en: Your companion ran; I am not chasing him.

lines.zh: 这道影子会一直跟到你停下。
lines.en: This shadow will follow until you stop.

lines.zh: 剑尖对着你的喉咙，别乱动。
lines.en: The point rests at your throat; do not fidget.

lines.zh: 我把盾面朝你，脚步不乱。
lines.en: I set my shield toward you, my pace steady.

lines.zh: 你数我走了几步，我数你的破绽。
lines.en: You count my steps; I count your openings.

lines.zh: 退到石阶上，你会站不稳。
lines.en: Step back onto the stairs and you will lose your footing.

lines.zh: 我的影子先到了你脚边。
lines.en: My shadow reached your feet before I did.

lines.zh: 剑落下，盔甲发出闷响。
lines.en: The sword falls; armor answers with a dull note.

lines.zh: 这一记是练了百年的角度。
lines.en: This angle was drilled for a hundred years.

lines.zh: 你挡得住一下，挡不住第三下。
lines.en: You can stop one; the third will find you.

lines.zh: 铁手套擦过你的肩。
lines.en: My gauntlet scrapes across your shoulder.

lines.zh: 劈开你的架势，不劈你的脸。
lines.en: I break your stance, not your face.

lines.zh: 骨头在盔里发力，没有肌肉帮忙。
lines.en: Bones drive the blow; no muscle helps them.

lines.zh: 你的木盾裂了，我听见了。
lines.en: Your wooden shield cracked; I heard it.

lines.zh: 退半步，下一剑更长。
lines.en: Step back, and the next cut reaches farther.

lines.zh: 我用的是剑背，先给你个警告。
lines.en: I strike with the flat first, as a warning.

lines.zh: 这一剑之后，你的手会发麻。
lines.en: After this cut, your arm will go numb.

lines.zh: 甲片挡住你的反击，响声很脆。
lines.en: My plate stops your counter with a bright ring.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊是留给活人的。
lines.en: I keep silent; shouting belongs to the living.

lines.zh: 剑从你肋侧过去，差半寸。
lines.en: The blade passes your ribs, half an inch short.

lines.zh: 站住别动，这样收尾最快。
lines.en: Stand still; that ends this fastest.

lines.zh: 这一剑从下往上，专挑护腿的缝。
lines.en: This swing comes low, aimed at the seam in your greaves.

lines.zh: 我被你挡开，甲片响了一声。
lines.en: You parry me, and my plates ring once.

lines.zh: 盔甲自己立起来，骨头在里头对齐。
lines.en: The armor stands up on its own; bones settle inside.

lines.zh: 我从土里被拔出来，锈还在。
lines.en: I am pulled from the soil, rust and all.

lines.zh: 是谁又把军旗竖起来了？
lines.en: Who raised the banner again?

lines.zh: 号令不清，但方向够用。
lines.en: The order is unclear, but the direction serves.

lines.zh: 这一觉睡得太久，甲缝里长了草。
lines.en: I slept too long; grass grew in my seams.

lines.zh: 骑士归位，剑先出鞘。
lines.en: The knight returns to post, sword first.

lines.zh: 我听见召我的声音，生涩又急。
lines.en: I hear the call that woke me, raw and hurried.

lines.zh: 骨头归骨，铁归铁，我归队。
lines.en: Bones to bones, iron to iron, I return to the ranks.

lines.zh: 地面裂开时，我正好站起来。
lines.en: The ground split just as I stood.

lines.zh: 这具身体我记得，肩甲有道凹痕。
lines.en: I know this body; there is a dent in the pauldron.

lines.zh: 军团又少一个位置，我来补。
lines.en: The legion lacks one place; I fill it.

lines.zh: 光刺进来，我把面甲放下。
lines.en: Light cuts in; I lower the visor.

lines.zh: 醒来的第一件事，是找剑。
lines.en: The first thing on waking is to find my sword.

lines.zh: 尘土落定，我已在哨位上。
lines.en: The dust settles, and I am already at my post.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的盔，里面的骨头在响。
lines.en: Fire heats my armor, and the bones inside knock.

lines.zh: 落地时，我把膝盖先递出去。
lines.en: On landing, I give the ground my knee first.

lines.zh: 水灌进面甲，我不需要喘气。
lines.en: Water fills my visor; I have no need to breathe.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻，甲片散了一地。
lines.en: The blast flips me over; plates scatter across the ground.

lines.zh: 箭卡在胸甲上，像根新铆钉。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my breastplate like a new rivet.

lines.zh: 那道光钻进骨头缝里，很凉。
lines.en: That light crawls into my joints, and it is cold.

lines.zh: 饿对我没用，我只剩骨架。
lines.en: Hunger means nothing; I am mostly frame.

lines.zh: 雷顺着头盔下来，脚底发亮。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my helm and lights my soles.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地面，我仍想站直。
lines.en: The void has no floor, yet I still try to stand.
